job.title: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer (all genders) | Augsburg

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, OCC web services, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of integrations across PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Experienced in agile delivery, CI/CD pipelines, production troubleshooting, and techno-functional stakeholder collaboration.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer (all genders)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer role in Augsburg. With over 5 years of professional experience building and optimizing large enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud & Backend Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: OCC APIs & Headless Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless custom data flows.

bullets.label: PIM, ERP & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized complex data pipelines using Profisee PIM, Hotfolders, and DataHub to ensure synchronized product catalogs across global e-commerce channels and enterprise systems.

bullets.label: Cloud Deployments & Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), ensuring high platform stability and performing database query optimization for improved transaction speeds.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my SAP Commerce expertise adds value to your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer (all genders)
cover_de.hook: mit großem Interesse bewerbe ich mich auf die Position als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer in Augsburg. Als SAP-zertifizierte Entwicklerin mit über 5 Jahren Berufserfahrung in der Konzeption, Implementierung und Betreuung von Enterprise-E-Commerce-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Expertise in Java, Spring und SAP Commerce Cloud mit.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud & Backend
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Implementierung von Backend-Funktionalitäten für SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java und Spring für Produkt-, Katalog-, Preis- und Kundendatenmanagement nach Best Practices.

bullets.label: REST APIs & OCC Integration
bullets.text: Bereitstellung von OCC REST Web Services und Headless-APIs sowie Anpassung von Interceptors, Populators und Converters für reibungslose, kundenspezifische Datenflüsse.

bullets.label: PIM & ERP Integrationen
bullets.text: Konzeption und Optimierung von PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines unter Verwendung von Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub zur Synchronisation von Produktkatalogen über globale Kanäle.

bullets.label: Cloud & Betrieb
bullets.text: Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen auf SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) sowie Durchführung von Datenbank-Query-Optimierungen zur Verbesserung der Transaktionsgeschwindigkeit.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer ordentlichen Kündigungsfrist mit letztem Arbeitstag am 15.12.2026. Ein Eintritt ist ab dem 16.12.2026 möglich. Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: I want to apply my 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) expertise, Java/Spring development skills, and robust integration background to help drive high-performing e-commerce solutions at your organization in Augsburg.
tailoring.motivation_short: Driving scalable enterprise e-commerce solutions with SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, and robust system integrations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) using Java, Spring, and OCC APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in your SAP Commerce Developer role in Augsburg. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer position. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms using Java, Spring, and SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in OCC REST APIs, PIM/ERP integrations, and CCv2 deployments.

I am available to start from 16 December 2026 (serving notice until 15.12.2026). I look forward to discussing my profile with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
